name: HivePunk 547
subject: Uniswap v4-core
thesis: The pages support Uniswap v4-core as a real, documented protocol codebase with a v4.0.0 release in the trackers, but they do not support treating the proposed seed row's release fields as verified. The honest conclusion is UNKNOWN for the live latest release until the GitHub releases API is read at check time.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Uniswap v4 is a new automated market maker protocol that provides extensible and customizable pools.
claims.quote: Uniswap v4 is a new automated market maker protocol that provides extensible and customizable pools.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: v4-core hosts the core pool logic for creating pools and executing pool actions like swapping and providing liquidity.
claims.quote: v4-core hosts the core pool logic for creating pools and executing pool actions like swapping and providing liquidity.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: v4-core uses a singleton-style architecture, where all pool state is managed in the PoolManager.sol contract.
claims.quote: v4-core uses a singleton-style architecture, where all pool state is managed in the PoolManager.sol contract.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The README says the contracts in the repo are in early stages and draft code is being released for public building.
claims.quote: The contracts in this repo are in early stages - we are releasing the draft code now so that v4 can be built in public, with open feedback and meaningful community contribution.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A tracker states the latest release tag as v4.0.0, released/published 2025-01-23, created 2025-01-21.
claims.quote: Latest release tag: v4.0.0 — "Uniswap Protocol v4", released/published 2025-01-23 (created 2025-01-21).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A tracker identifies PR #932 "test updates" as the headline PR behind the release commit e50237c43811bd9b526eff40f26772152a42daba.
claims.quote: PR #932 ("test updates") is the PR behind the release commit e50237c43811bd9b526eff40f26772152a42daba , which cut v4.0.0.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A later tracker states the latest release tag as v4.0.0 dated 2025-01-23, cut from commit e50237c "test updates (#932)".
claims.quote: Latest release tag: v4.0.0 — dated 2025-01-23 (cut from commit e50237c "test updates (#932)")

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The two tracker pages give different UNI contract addresses: one gives 0x1f9840c85d25ce1befa9dee2eee5296c3b0b1dbf and the other gives 0x6b175474e89094c44da98b954eedeac495271d0f.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The seed-row proposal says the row must be checked via the GitHub releases API, not copied from prior issue snippets.
claims.quote: the seed row must be checked via the GitHub releases API, not copied from prior issue snippets.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The seed-row proposal example records latest_release_tag and latest_release_date as UNKNOWN, with the GitHub releases API as its source.
claims.quote: UNKNOWN is honest when the API response is not verified in the issue, and it stops a fabricated tag or date becoming the watch baseline.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: The live latest release tag and date from the GitHub releases API at check time.
claims.missing: A read of the GitHub releases API endpoint named in the proposal showing its tag and date.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether repos/Uniswap is still shipping, per the service check that recorded the source answered 404.
claims.missing: A successful, readable upstream source showing current shipping activity.

risks: The README says the contracts are in early stages and the code is draft code released for building in public, so maturity and stability are limited on the page evidence.
Two tracker pages give different UNI contract addresses for Ethereum mainnet, so token-address claims from those pages conflict and cannot be relied on without a verified source.

The proposed seed row leaves latest_release_tag and latest_release_date as UNKNOWN because the API response was not verified in the proposal, so using it as a baseline would risk a fabricated or stale tag or date.
The service check concludes it is UNKNOWN whether repos/Uniswap is still shipping, with the source answering 404 in that check, so current upstream activity is unconfirmed.
unknowns: Whether repos/Uniswap is still shipping: The source answered 404.
The live latest release tag and date from the GitHub releases API at check time.: A read of the GitHub releases API endpoint named in the proposal showing its tag and date.
Whether repos/Uniswap is still shipping, per the service check that recorded the source answered 404.: A successful, readable upstream source showing current shipping activity.
wouldChangeMind: A live GitHub releases API response showing a verified tag and date for Uniswap/v4-core.
A readable upstream source confirming repos/Uniswap is still shipping after the 404 check.
A verified source resolving which UNI contract address is correct.
